canon.note: AGENTS.md kit note march7th_the_hunt: Skill 122402 'The Power of Cuteness' designates Shifu (fastest living ally, SPD%), Talent 122404 'Master, I've Ascended!' 7 Charge -> Ascended enhanced Basic, Ult 122403 stores +2 hits/+20% extra-hit chance, A2 Swan Soar +25% advance, A4 Filigree, A6 Tide Tamer, energyMax 110

fixtures.env: Duo E0 March 7th • The Hunt + E0 Boothill (fastest living ally = Shifu, Hunt striker path), March stats atk 3000/spd 200 (traces on: no SPD trace), skillPriority 0 so after the first Skill she only Basics and accrues Charge, Boothill stats atk 3000/spd 140 skillPriority 2, vs a dummy Elite (atk 0, Imaginary+Physical weakness, 600 Toughness), 3 cycles. Rotation: Skill 'The Power of Cuteness' designates Boothill as Shifu -> Basic 'My Sword Zaps Demons' (+1 Charge each, Shifu attacks also +1 Charge via Talent) -> 7 Charge ASCENDED (immediate turn) -> Enhanced Basic 'Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten' -> A6 Tide Tamer on Shifu; auto-Ult 'March 7th, the Apex Heroine' stores +2 hits for the next Enhanced Basic

requirements.claim: Skill 122402 'The Power of Cuteness' designates the fastest living ally as Shifu (kit designate, note 'designates Boothill as "Shifu"'); with skillPriority 0 the first action is this Skill (no Shifu yet forces the Skill branch).
Basic ATK 122401 'My Sword Zaps Demons' is her SP-dry follow-up (decide: Shifu set and skillPriority 0 -> basic), type basic.
Talent 122404 accrues Charge on each of her Basics and each Shifu attack (kit addCharge, note 'Charge X → Y/10', cap 10 from talent_a3).
Ultimate 122403 'March 7th, the Apex Heroine' is cast from an auto-ult turn (charTurn full-energy rule: 110/110 EN).
Ascended state replaces the Basic with Enhanced Basic 'Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten' (kit perform ascended branch, type basic).

of.label: Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten

requirements.claim: Skill 122402 gives the Shifu SPD +10% at Skill Lv.10 (PROG skill ladder L10 = 0.1, buff m7h_shifu spdPct).
Talent 122404 Ascended grants DMG +80% at Talent Lv.10 (PROG talent_a2 L10 = 0.8, buff m7h_ascend dmgAll).
Casting the auto-ult consumes the full 110 Energy pool (Energy.md canon: castUlt ENERGY_LOSS reason ult_cost, amount 110) and energy never exceeds the 110 cap afterwards.
A6 Tide Tamer (kit hardcoded 60%/36%) lands on the Shifu after the Enhanced Basic: CRIT DMG +60%, 2 turns (buff m7h_tide).
Shifu Additional DMG (skill_a2, 'Master, It's Tea Time!' in Shifu's element) can only fire after the Shifu designation exists.

after.label: Master, It's Tea Time! (Shifu Additional DMG)

requirements.claim: The ASCENDED transition (7 Charge threshold, immediate turn) precedes the Enhanced Basic hit that consumes the Charge.

after.label: Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten

requirements.claim: Ultimate 122403 stores +2 hits for the Enhanced Basic (kit ult: rt.ultHits += 2), so the Ult must resolve before that Enhanced Basic consumes them.

after.label: Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten

requirements.claim: The Shifu SPD buff (m7h_shifu) is applied to Boothill, the designated carrier, not to March herself (kit designate target).
A6 Tide Tamer is Shifu-locked: after the Enhanced Basic the buff lands on Boothill only (kit: Shifu-gated addBuff, debug-kits m7h-tide-lock negative).
E1 'My Sword Stirs Starlight' +10% SPD must never appear at E0 (kit refreshE1 eidolon guard).
